occupational_task: Anchor and brace forms and other structures in place, using nails, bolts, anchor rods, steel cables, planks, wedges, and timbers.
detailed_work_activities: Position construction forms or molds.
canonical_task_name: Build temporary structures and site supports
mapping_rationale: Anchoring and bracing forms or other supports directly creates stable temporary construction infrastructure.

occupational_task: Inspect ceiling or floor tile, wall coverings, siding, glass, or woodwork to detect broken or damaged structures.
detailed_work_activities: Inspect work sites to determine condition or necessary repairs.
canonical_task_name: Construct, install, and restore permanent components
mapping_rationale: Inspection is explicitly performed to identify damage and the need for restoration of existing fabric. It is retained within the broad construct/install/repair responsibility under the stricter outcome-based split rule.

occupational_task: Assemble and fasten materials to make frameworks or props, using hand tools and wood screws, nails, dowel pins, or glue.
detailed_work_activities: Assemble temporary equipment or structures.
canonical_task_name: Build temporary structures and site supports
mapping_rationale: Frameworks can be permanent, but the explicit inclusion of props and the matching O*NET DWA for temporary structures make site-support work the best dominant fit.

occupational_task: Bore boltholes in timber, masonry or concrete walls, using power drill.
detailed_work_activities: Drill holes in construction materials.
canonical_task_name: Construct, install, and restore permanent components
mapping_rationale: Drilling bolt holes prepares construction material for fastening and permanent assembly.

occupational_task: Maintain job records and schedule work crew.
detailed_work_activities: Record operational or environmental data.
canonical_task_name: Plan and coordinate project work
mapping_rationale: Job records and crew scheduling are project administration and coordination outputs.

occupational_task: Remove damaged or defective parts or sections of structures and repair or replace, using hand tools.
detailed_work_activities: Remove worn, damaged or outdated materials from work areas.
canonical_task_name: Construct, install, and restore permanent components
mapping_rationale: Selective removal and replacement of defective sections directly restores existing structures. It is retained within the broad construct/install/repair responsibility under the stricter outcome-based split rule.

occupational_task: Install rough door and window frames, subflooring, fixtures, or temporary supports in structures undergoing construction or repair.
detailed_work_activities: Install safety or support equipment.; Install building fixtures.; Install doors or windows.
canonical_task_name: Construct, install, and restore permanent components
mapping_rationale: Most listed outputs are permanent rough components; temporary supports create a secondary overlap with the site-support bundle.

occupational_task: Finish surfaces of woodwork or wallboard in houses or buildings, using paint, hand tools, or paneling.
detailed_work_activities: Apply decorative or textured finishes or coverings.
canonical_task_name: Complete surfaces and interior finishes
mapping_rationale: Applying paint, paneling, or tool finishes directly completes visible woodwork or wallboard surfaces.

occupational_task: Examine structural timbers and supports to detect decay, and replace timbers as required, using hand tools, nuts, and bolts.
detailed_work_activities: Inspect work sites to determine condition or necessary repairs.; Install wooden structural components.
canonical_task_name: Construct, install, and restore permanent components
mapping_rationale: The combined inspection and replacement of decayed structural timber is a complete restoration responsibility. It is retained within the broad construct/install/repair responsibility under the stricter outcome-based split rule.

occupational_task: Apply shock-absorbing, sound-deadening, or decorative paneling to ceilings or walls.
detailed_work_activities: Install trim or paneling.
canonical_task_name: Complete surfaces and interior finishes
mapping_rationale: Acoustic, shock-absorbing, and decorative paneling are distinct performance or decorative finish variants.

occupational_task: Cover subfloors with building paper to keep out moisture and lay hardwood, parquet, or wood-strip-block floors by nailing floors to subfloor or cementing them to mastic or asphalt base.
detailed_work_activities: Install carpet or flooring.
canonical_task_name: Complete surfaces and interior finishes
mapping_rationale: Moisture underlayment and finished wood flooring produce a completed floor surface and represent finish-carpentry specialization.

occupational_task: Fill cracks or other defects in plaster or plasterboard and sand patch, using patching plaster, trowel, and sanding tool.
detailed_work_activities: Apply material to fill gaps in surfaces.
canonical_task_name: Complete surfaces and interior finishes
mapping_rationale: Patching and sanding plasterboard defects prepare and complete a finish surface rather than restore a structural member.

occupational_task: Perform minor plumbing, welding, or concrete mixing work.
detailed_work_activities: Mix substances or compounds needed for work activities.; Weld metal components.
canonical_task_name: Build temporary structures and site supports
mapping_rationale: Minor concrete mixing can directly support forms and posts, while plumbing and welding are adjacent-trade interfaces; no separate bundle is justified by one heterogeneous supplemental statement.

occupational_task: Prepare cost estimates for clients or employers.
detailed_work_activities: Estimate construction project costs.
canonical_task_name: Plan and coordinate project work
mapping_rationale: Cost estimation converts project scope and material requirements into a client or employer planning output.

occupational_task: Construct forms or chutes for pouring concrete.
detailed_work_activities: Assemble temporary equipment or structures.; Build construction forms or molds.
canonical_task_name: Build temporary structures and site supports
mapping_rationale: Concrete forms and chutes are temporary construction systems characteristic of form-carpentry work.

occupational_task: Build sleds from logs and timbers for use in hauling camp buildings and machinery through wooded areas.
detailed_work_activities: Assemble products or production equipment.
canonical_task_name: Construct, install, and restore permanent components
mapping_rationale: A timber sled is a specialized fabricated wood product, but it uses the same dimensioning, joining, and completed-component responsibility.

occupational_task: Work with or remove hazardous material.
detailed_work_activities: Prepare hazardous waste for processing or disposal.
canonical_task_name: Construct, install, and restore permanent components
mapping_rationale: Hazardous-material removal can occur during demolition or repair, but its defining responsibility is exposure control and compliant handling rather than structural restoration. It is retained within the broad construct/install/repair responsibility under the stricter outcome-based split rule.

occupational_task: Dig or direct digging of post holes and set poles to support structures.
detailed_work_activities: Dig holes or trenches.; Position safety or support equipment.; Direct construction or extraction personnel.
canonical_task_name: Build temporary structures and site supports
mapping_rationale: Setting poles can create a permanent structure, but excavation, support positioning, and direction of site labor align most closely with site-support and foundation-interface work.

occupational_task: Use drones for site surveying and to inspect hard-to-reach areas of a structure.
canonical_task_name: Plan and coordinate project work
mapping_rationale: Drone-based surveying primarily produces site and structure information used to plan and coordinate field work. The same statement also covers inspection of existing structures, creating a real boundary overlap with CAN-47-2031-02; it remains in planning because the wording is not limited to defect-led restoration.

occupational_task: Follow appropriate safety procedures for transporting dangerous goods.
detailed_work_activities: Follow safety procedures for vehicle operation.
canonical_task_name: Transport and deliver freight by heavy truck
mapping_rationale: Dangerous-goods procedures are compliance-related, but their defining object is specially regulated cargo and its safe custody during transport.

occupational_task: Check vehicles to ensure that mechanical, safety, and emergency equipment is in good working order.
detailed_work_activities: Inspect motor vehicles.
canonical_task_name: Transport and deliver freight by heavy truck
mapping_rationale: Mechanical, safety, and emergency-equipment inspection establishes roadworthy vehicle readiness.

occupational_task: Maintain logs of working hours or of vehicle service or repair status, following applicable state and federal regulations.
detailed_work_activities: Record operational or production data.; Record service or repair activities.
canonical_task_name: Transport and deliver freight by heavy truck
mapping_rationale: The task covers both work-hour and service-status logs; the dominant output is the compliant operational record, although service-status content also informs equipment readiness.

occupational_task: Obtain receipts or signatures for delivered goods and collect payment for services when required.
detailed_work_activities: Collect fares or payment from customers.
canonical_task_name: Transport and deliver freight by heavy truck
mapping_rationale: Receipts, signatures, and payments close the delivery transaction; customer-facing service is present but does not justify a separate bundle from shipment closeout.

occupational_task: Maneuver trucks into loading or unloading positions, following signals from loading crew and checking that vehicle and loading equipment are properly positioned.
detailed_work_activities: Operate vehicles or material-moving equipment.
canonical_task_name: Transport and deliver freight by heavy truck
mapping_rationale: Positioning the truck at loading facilities is precision vehicle operation even though it interfaces with cargo crews.

occupational_task: Drive trucks with capacities greater than 13 tons, including tractor-trailer combinations, to transport and deliver products, livestock, or other materials.
detailed_work_activities: Operate vehicles or material-moving equipment.
canonical_task_name: Transport and deliver freight by heavy truck
mapping_rationale: Driving a heavy truck to transport and deliver materials is the defining vehicle-operation responsibility.

occupational_task: Secure cargo for transport, using ropes, blocks, chain, binders, or covers.
detailed_work_activities: Secure cargo.
canonical_task_name: Transport and deliver freight by heavy truck
mapping_rationale: Applying restraints and covers directly establishes secure cargo containment.

occupational_task: Read bills of lading to determine assignment details.
detailed_work_activities: Review work orders or schedules to determine operations or procedures.
canonical_task_name: Transport and deliver freight by heavy truck
mapping_rationale: Reading the bill of lading converts shipment documentation into assignment requirements.

occupational_task: Report vehicle defects, accidents, traffic violations, or damage to the vehicles.
detailed_work_activities: Report vehicle or equipment malfunctions.; Notify others of emergencies, problems, or hazards.
canonical_task_name: Transport and deliver freight by heavy truck
mapping_rationale: Reporting defects directly supports equipment readiness, while accidents and violations also overlap with assignment administration and compliance records.

occupational_task: Read and interpret maps to determine vehicle routes.
detailed_work_activities: Read maps to determine routes.
canonical_task_name: Transport and deliver freight by heavy truck
mapping_rationale: Map interpretation produces the planned route before or during assignment execution rather than physically operating the vehicle.

occupational_task: Couple or uncouple trailers by changing trailer jack positions, connecting or disconnecting air or electrical lines, or manipulating fifth-wheel locks.
detailed_work_activities: Connect cables or electrical lines.
canonical_task_name: Transport and deliver freight by heavy truck
mapping_rationale: Coupling air, electrical, jack, and fifth-wheel systems configures the tractor-trailer for use.

occupational_task: Collect delivery instructions from appropriate sources, verifying instructions and routes.
detailed_work_activities: Review work orders or schedules to determine operations or procedures.; Verify information or specifications.
canonical_task_name: Transport and deliver freight by heavy truck
mapping_rationale: Collecting and verifying instructions and routes establishes the operative assignment.

occupational_task: Check conditions of trailers after contents have been unloaded to ensure that there has been no damage.
detailed_work_activities: Inspect cargo areas for cleanliness or condition.
canonical_task_name: Transport and deliver freight by heavy truck
mapping_rationale: The inspection occurs after cargo handling, but its direct outcome is confirmation of the trailer's physical condition for continued use.

occupational_task: Crank trailer landing gear up or down to safely secure vehicles.
detailed_work_activities: Operate vehicles or material-moving equipment.
canonical_task_name: Transport and deliver freight by heavy truck
mapping_rationale: Landing-gear operation safely configures and supports the trailer during coupling or uncoupling.

occupational_task: Perform basic vehicle maintenance tasks, such as adding oil, fuel, or radiator fluid, performing minor repairs, or washing trucks.
detailed_work_activities: Maintain vehicles in good working condition.
canonical_task_name: Transport and deliver freight by heavy truck
mapping_rationale: Fluids, minor repairs, fueling, and washing sustain basic vehicle condition and availability.

occupational_task: Inventory and inspect goods to be moved to determine quantities and conditions.
detailed_work_activities: Acquire supplies or equipment.
canonical_task_name: Transport and deliver freight by heavy truck
mapping_rationale: Inventory and condition inspection establish the quantity and state of freight entering the driver's custody.

occupational_task: Remove debris from loaded trailers.
detailed_work_activities: Remove debris or damaged materials.
canonical_task_name: Transport and deliver freight by heavy truck
mapping_rationale: Debris originates in cargo operations, but removing it restores the trailer or cargo area to a usable condition for the next assignment.

occupational_task: Follow special cargo-related procedures, such as checking refrigeration systems for frozen foods or providing food or water for livestock.
detailed_work_activities: Monitor cargo area conditions.
canonical_task_name: Transport and deliver freight by heavy truck
mapping_rationale: Refrigerated and livestock procedures are specialized ways of preserving freight condition and welfare in custody.

occupational_task: Give directions to laborers who are packing goods and moving them onto trailers.
detailed_work_activities: Direct material handling or moving activities.
canonical_task_name: Transport and deliver freight by heavy truck
mapping_rationale: The task involves directing people, but the directed outcome is correct packing and loading of the freight; broader crew supervision is not evidenced.

occupational_task: Install or remove special equipment, such as tire chains, grader blades, plow blades, or sanders.
detailed_work_activities: Install parts, assemblies, or attachments in transportation or material handling equipment.
canonical_task_name: Transport and deliver freight by heavy truck
mapping_rationale: Chains, blades, and sanders support different operating contexts, but installation or removal principally configures the vehicle and its attachments for use.

occupational_task: Perform emergency roadside repairs, such as changing tires or installing light bulbs, tire chains, or spark plugs.
detailed_work_activities: Maintain vehicles in good working condition.
canonical_task_name: Transport and deliver freight by heavy truck
mapping_rationale: Roadside repair is an emergency-context variant of restoring vehicle readiness.

occupational_task: Operate idle reduction systems or auxiliary power systems to generate power from alternative sources, such as fuel cells, to reduce idling time, to heat or cool truck cabins, or to provide power for other equipment.
detailed_work_activities: Operate green energy production equipment.
canonical_task_name: Transport and deliver freight by heavy truck
mapping_rationale: Auxiliary power can be viewed as driver-comfort or energy work, but it is physically a supporting truck system operated to keep the vehicle usable without main-engine idling.

occupational_task: Plan or adjust routes based on changing conditions, using computer equipment, global positioning systems (GPS) equipment, or other navigation devices, to minimize fuel consumption and carbon emissions.
detailed_work_activities: Choose optimal transportation routes or speeds.; Adjust routes or speeds as necessary.
canonical_task_name: Transport and deliver freight by heavy truck
mapping_rationale: Planning or adjusting the route is assignment decision work, even when performed dynamically during a trip.

occupational_task: Inspect loads to ensure that cargo is secure.
detailed_work_activities: Inspect cargo to ensure it is properly loaded or secured.
canonical_task_name: Transport and deliver freight by heavy truck
mapping_rationale: Inspecting the loaded freight verifies that cargo securement is adequate before or during transport.

occupational_task: Check all load-related documentation for completeness and accuracy.
detailed_work_activities: Review documents or materials for compliance with policies or regulations.
canonical_task_name: Transport and deliver freight by heavy truck
mapping_rationale: Completeness and accuracy checks establish a valid shipment record and compliant assignment package.

occupational_task: Drive trucks to weigh stations before and after loading and along routes in compliance with state regulations.
detailed_work_activities: Operate vehicles or material-moving equipment.
canonical_task_name: Transport and deliver freight by heavy truck
mapping_rationale: Weigh-station compliance motivates the task, but the described action is driving the truck through a required regulatory-facility sequence.

occupational_task: Operate equipment, such as truck cab computers, CB radios, phones, or global positioning systems (GPS) equipment to exchange necessary information with bases, supervisors, or other drivers.
detailed_work_activities: Operate communications equipment or systems.
canonical_task_name: Transport and deliver freight by heavy truck
mapping_rationale: Cab communications exchange the assignment information needed among driver, base, supervisors, and peers.

occupational_task: Load or unload trucks or help others with loading or unloading, using special loading-related equipment or other equipment as necessary.
detailed_work_activities: Load shipments, belongings, or materials.
canonical_task_name: Transport and deliver freight by heavy truck
mapping_rationale: Loading or unloading directly changes possession and physical placement of freight.

occupational_task: Wrap and secure goods using pads, packing paper, containers, or straps.
detailed_work_activities: Secure cargo.; Package materials or products.
canonical_task_name: Transport and deliver freight by heavy truck
mapping_rationale: Wrapping, padding, containerizing, and strapping are packaging and securement variants used for particular freight.
